page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. A marginal note stands in the right margin beside the line "in unita-te". The running head "PARS PRIMA." and the page number "31" are at the top. A psalm title and verse heading sit above the first paragraph of Psalm 122's commentary. At the foot, the catchword "plo" stands at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: ritu excellentiæ suò, & lecturos omnes afficiat
eiusdem excellentiæ suæ studio ac conscientiâ,
ut viam excellentem hanc insistamus omnes,
& ad finem perfectionemque illius uno animo
contendamus in Christo Iesu unico, æterno, &
perfecto seruatore nostro. Cùm autem duo ca-
pita de Pace receperimus, ante[?] nos esse dictu-
ros: Unum, de Re & Modo ipsius: Alterum, de
Fructibus: Iam auctore Domino venturi sumus
ad prioris explicationem, prout verba nobis san-
ctus ille Dei Spiritus præiuit olim per Daui-
dem Psalmo 122. & nobis in eundem Psal-
mum dicendi gratiam admensurus est.
PSALMVS. 122.
1. Lætor de dicentibus mihi, Eamus
in domum Iehoue.
Huius psalmi Finis est, ut Deus in Eccle-
sia sua glorificetur intus fide, foris obse-
quio fidei omnibusq. officiis pietatis, in unita-
te Spiritus per vinculum pacis. Summa est, Fru-
ctum Spiritus in omnibus piis esse gaudium spi-
rituale, & pacem in iustitia; quam pacem Deus in
Christo publicè dedit ecclesiæ, & singulis mem-
bris illius, in se, atq. inter se colendâ cum Deo,
& secundum Deum. Partes itaque duæ sunt:
Nam primùm loquitur Psaltes de spirituali piorum

page.notes: The printed "Hvivs" has a large initial H; read as Huius with u/v corrected. The word "ante" after "receperimus" is partly obscured by the printed comma and is marked [?]. The left edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and show-through, not transcribed. The faint handwritten figures top right are not printed text and are left out. The line "exem-" ends the text; "plo" below right is the catchword, the start of the next page's word "exemplo".
